area: Keystone testbed: the arena as an authored TileMap document

find.report_claim: tilemap was one of 21 Keystone modules the shooter had never imported; it turns an immutable grid into exact AABB colliders, one merged mesh and a round-trippable document
find.live_evidence: levels.json already publishes a 40 m arena with a wall height and seven cover boxes, so an authoring proof needs no renderer and no gameplay change
find.consumer_evidence: the built TileMap has 143 solid cells, 143 colliders and a merged mesh of 9260 vertices / 4630 triangles; to_dict/from_dict reproduce an equal map

read: projects/keystone/keystone/tilemap.py: TileMap, colliders(), mesh(), to_dict(), from_dict(), tilemap_report()
shooter/data/levels.json: arena size 40, wall_height 3, seven covers
killed: adding the tile colliders or mesh to the live scene: that would change physics and draw budget, i.e. the sim and its replay hash
authoring a separate tile JSON file: would duplicate levels.json and create two sources of truth
per-frame tile reports: cycle 180 measured the cost of per-frame queries; this stays on demand
analyze.survivor: an on-demand arena_tile_report() that derives a TileMap from the shipped covers and reports tile stats, a round-tripped document, collider count and merged-mesh size
